### Added

- (agent-platform) [Accept tls://host:port in Extra egress origins](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3179) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — An agent's `Extra egress origins` field accepts `tls://<host>:<port>`, e.g. `tls://db.example.com:5432`, for non-HTTP TLS services such as a database, beside `http(s)://` origins. Needs agent-manager 2.8.0 or later.
- (agent-platform) [Session workspace chip and drawer, Workspace column](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3180) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — A session started in a workspace shows it in its header with the last sync and the repositories fetched fresh; clicking it lists the repositories, the session's directory and its cleanup date. The Sessions list and the session rail name the workspace too.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.15.0...v3.16.0
